title: Loaves and Fish Count-and-Share Sheet
purpose: Support the primary activity for Jesus Feeds the Crowd.
body_markdown:
# Loaves and Fish Count-and-Share Sheet

Use John 6:1-14 as your evidence.

1. Write or draw three direct observations.
2. Mark one interpretation or conclusion.
3. Name one careful response.
4. Put a question mark beside anything the passage does not settle by itself.
